# @skyline-js/cache

> 标签: api cache, cache, cache invalidation, caching, database cache, express cache, local, memory, memory cache, multi, nest cache, nestjs cache, node cache, node-cache, node.js cache, redis cache, ttl cache

## 简介

Fast, reliable and zero dependency cache with built-in cache inconsistency observability and reporting. Supports any storage engine, in-memory and Redis come out of the box.
